scientific_question: Can a cross-context gene-coordinate calibration of the same-target Pan2025 H1 residual improve the frozen production-shaped incumbent while suppressing H1-specific coordinates?

hypothesis.input: q[h,t] = norm-matched Pan effect in destination family h's fixed operator geometry minus destination incumbent m[h,t]
hypothesis.teacher: r[c->h,t] = permitted teacher-family raw uncentered truth minus the destination incumbent m[h,t]; all terms for one fit remain in destination h's coordinate system
hypothesis.calibration: no-intercept nonnegative diagonal least squares shrunk toward one pooled scalar and clipped to [0,1]
hypothesis.pan_role: input only; Pan is never a teacher, outcome, or whitener basis

data_boundary.response_axis: Experiment 132 frozen 4,992-gene axis excluding all 300 VCC coordinates and all 1,023 gallery-target coordinates

incumbent_and_pan_geometry.baseline: Experiment 140 identity-reproduction-v5 production-shaped non-PerturbMatch surrogate baselines
incumbent_and_pan_geometry.pan_centering: subtract the mean Pan effect over authenticated rows outside all 1,023 Experiment 132 gallery targets; the sealed 410 are excluded by name and their effect values are never read
incumbent_and_pan_geometry.pan_scale: after outer-operator application, norm-match each Pan row to the corresponding incumbent row
incumbent_and_pan_geometry.pan_support: every selected 613 x 4,992 coordinate must be measured; unsupported rows or coordinates would be exact identity
incumbent_and_pan_geometry.perturbmatch_status: omitted by the frozen Experiment 140 comparator; a positive result requires a separate exact-a15 613-target follow-up before independent confirmation

teacher_policy.reason: K562 cannot teach a non-K562 destination because the frozen non-K562 surrogate contains the K562 donor slot; every fitted coordinate map also stays inside one fixed outer-operator geometry.

cross_fitting.candidate_selection: none; diag_rho050 is the sole primary fixed before development outcome access

conditional_inference.null_scope: repeat the fixed five-fold cross-fitting procedure for diag_rho050; there is no candidate selection
conditional_inference.target_label_operation: apply one frozen target derangement shared across families and folds to the transformed Pan rows before destination-row norm matching; incumbent rows and outcomes remain fixed
conditional_inference.coordinate_operation: apply one frozen response-coordinate derangement shared across families and folds to transformed Pan rows before destination-row norm matching; incumbent rows and outcomes remain fixed

distinctness.experiment_117: Direct Pan interpolation and fraction tuning are closed; scalar_control cannot promote.
distinctness.experiment_129: No Pan target-neighbor retrieval is used.
distinctness.experiment_132: No DepMap response prediction or replacement is used.
distinctness.experiment_136: No Ridge residual, margin router, or Ridge-derived confidence is used.
distinctness.experiment_096: Experiment 096 rejected unrestricted per-gene model-to-truth slopes as cell-line-specific. Experiment 141 instead fits a clipped nonnegative reliability map for an external same-target Pan residual around an unchanged incumbent and must materially beat its scalar ancestry control.
